digest.component_or_area: rebar graph link store and reconciler inbound removal
propositions: Link writes are relation-scoped (keyed on target_id, relation) so one pair can hold multiple differently-related deps (e.g. blocks + relates_to), but removals are pair-scoped (no relation argument), causing write-remove asymmetry

When inbound removal reaches G5 mismatch guard because outbound ADD is deduped direction-agnostically by vendor type, the pair-scoped unlink permanently declines and never converges, re-emitting and re-declining every pass

Relation-scoped removal seam at graph layer (remove_dependency symmetric with add_dependency) with optional relation parameter in CLI and library facade maintains backward compatibility while enabling convergence
When inbound unlink names a relation with no matching net-active local link, removal must be a logged no-op, never removing a different relation's link the peer still carries
